rmk:
Sounds like a Soricidae. The recorder was placed on a wooden pole 2.3 m above the ground in the marsh surrounding the pond. This could perhaps point towards water shrew (Neomys fodiens) (?) 
Simple calculation of signal/noise ratio: dBmax - dBmin = -21.51 dB - (-52.57 dB) = 31.06 dB (i.e. quality C).
For additional information see: <https://www.artsobservasjoner.no/Sighting/37121374> (in norwegian).

SNR 26dB(ISO/ITU) @ t/10 (still sound quality C) ref. [Article 275](https://xeno-canto.org/article/275)
